reviews.text: I cannot say enough positive things about Tracy, Taylor, and the rest of the team.  We’ve been using Tracy for the past few years and recently had Taylor for our last pet sit.  They are both SO kind, fear free, and really spoil our pets. I swear they get so much extra love when we’re gone.  We recently had an unexpected issue come up with our trip and they went above and beyond to make sure our pets were cared for. I’m soooooo thankful.  Also, the journals and pictures are an added bonus.  I do not hesitate in recommending them and am so glad we have them to watch our crew. Thank you Tracy and Taylor!

Yesspet Pet Care is hands down the best in the business for your pet care needs. We have used their services numerous times and are always able to enjoy our trips stress and worry free knowing our pet is in great hands. Yesspet Pet Care is extremely attentive to your pet’s needs and excellent in communication about daily visits and overnight stays. Every time we return our dog is happy, healthy, and relaxed. Letting him stay on his normal routine with extra TLC is a huge bonus. Yesspet Pet Care is the way to go for all of your travel needs.

We have two huskies (brothers). The regular reports and the photos all demonstrate that they were well cared for by conscientious, caring Yesspet staff. Leaving them at home while we travel is tough, but they were happy and well cared for in our absence.

We used Yesspet to care for our three guinea pigs on several occasions. The sitters were great with our girls, and kept us informed with pictures from every visit. Outstanding care and kindness. We highly recommend them!

This service was phenomenal! I was so happy to get the journal entries each visit and I could see my dog was happy and calm while I was away. I would recommend this service to anyone who wants to make sure they’re animals are safe, loved, and cared for while they are away!

Over the past 14 months I have experienced multiple unenviable and highly unexpected situations that lead to losses for our family.  When I could plan ahead to be away, I coordinated with Tracy, but far too often I was texting her with new, urgent requests for petsitting care.  As a long-standing client Tracy knew this wasn’t my normal way of operating and so she did everything she could to accommodate our pet care needs.  When my latest trip extended so I could be there with my Dad when he passed, Tracy and her team took my dog for car rides and on a field trip to shop for supplies when we ran out.  They spruced up my home, collected mail and packages, they diligently sent photos and updates from the house, fully removing any worries I could have had so that I could stay focused on my Dad.  Most of what I described is Yesspet’s standard service but when I needed it most, they went above and beyond to provide for my dog and my home the way that I would when I simply couldn’t.  Thank you to the entire team, Emmett and Cari.
For the past years we only use Yesspet when we go out of town. They have always done an amazing job taking care of our puppies. I wouldn't trust anyone else with the job.

I am so lucky to have Yesspet in my neighborhood for taking care of our two pups when we are out of town.   For an 8 day trip we tried out the Tuck in service and loved it.  So did our dogs.   The pet sitter arrives in the evening, stays for 90 minutes playing and getting everyone ready for bed.   They leave the house for the night and are back again early in the morning to let everyone outside, have breakfast and go for walks.    We also added two extra check on visits for more walks and an early dinner.   Lots of dog photos and happy dog and calm dogs when we walked in the door made us feel very good about our decision.  We have used Yesspets for years and we are so happy.  They are trained, friendly, reliable and trustworthy.    Really wonderful service.

I cannot say enough great things about Tracy and YessPets. From start to finish, the care and professionalism were outstanding. I have a new puppy and was extremely anxious about leaving her for a 10-day trip. Tracy came highly recommended by my dog trainer, and she exceeded every expectation.

Tracy stayed in my home, caring for my puppy and keeping an eye on my house while I was away. When my dog unexpectedly became sick, Tracy acted immediately. She kept me fully informed with multiple daily updates, photos, and detailed reports on how she was doing. We discussed the situation together, and she even took her to the vet when needed — something I was incredibly grateful for while being out of town.

Knowing that Tracy has extensive training and certifications in pet care made a huge difference. Instead of worrying, I felt calm and confident that my dog was receiving knowledgeable, compassionate care. Beyond handling the medical issue, Tracy spent quality time with my puppy every day — walking her, playing with her, and providing enrichment that kept her happy and engaged.

By the time I returned home, it was clear my dog had been loved and well cared for. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Tracy and YessPets to anyone looking for a reliable, experienced, and truly caring dog sitter. They are simply the best.

The Yesspet Team is an outstanding group of talented, caring and loving associates. We have used their exceptional services for many years. I would highly recommend them to any pet owner in the Ahwatukee area.

Tracy, Brooke, Taylor, and Julie are an absolutely FANTASTIC team! The Yesspet team comes over while I’m at work (I work 10 hour days far from Ahwatukee) to provide enrichment for Oakley, a walk, and of course lots and lots of pets. The care & service they provide for Oakley is unmatched, and I’ve never felt more comfortable with someone else caring for my dog. Oakley also LOVES them. They also leave a detailed update on how the mid-day visit went and tons of pictures :). I’m so happy I found Tracy and her team, as they give me peace of mind while I’m at work and I love how much they love on Oakley. I cannot recommend them enough! Will absolutely use them for pet sitting in the future if my usual friends are ever unavailable when I travel.

We had such a positive experience with Yesspet Pet Care. We have a dog with refractory epilepsy and we’re always wary to leave him as anxiety is a huge seizure trigger for him. Yesspet made us feel so comfortable leaving our pup (and and kitties, and lizard!) with them while we went away. It’s always a little scary using a pet sitter for the first time but their updates and constant communication were so helpful. When we came home, our animals were relaxed and didn’t seem anxious at all. We will definitely use Yesspet again. Taylor was so wonderful with our pets and we feel so grateful to people nearby we trust!
We love Tracy and her awesome service! My dogs are always well cared for and I never stress leaving them in her care. She simply is amazing and I can’t recommend her enough!
Best Pet Sitters in Ahwatukee AZ

Yesspet is the absolute best service for your fur family. Several years ago, when traveling abroad we had a sketchy experience with pet care.  We found Tracy, Taylor and their team and I cannot stress how happy we are because of their care and professionalism.  It feels like you are leaving your pets and home in the care of family. The enrichment and toys are a bonus!  They are exceptional!!

Yesspet Pawsitive Pet Sitters with Tracy and the team provide excellent, professional pet care. Their attention to detail and compassion give us peace of mind when we are away from our two pups Mandy & Oscar. Mandy requires insulin which Yesspet is able to administer.  I highly recommend them for their patience, reliability, communication and genuine love for animals. I also love the online platform that Yesspet provides. Amazing!

I have used Yesspet several times and always been extremely impressed by their services. The petsitters are all diligent and caring. They take excellent care of my dogs & cat and send detailed notes and photos after each visit. They go above and beyond every time, engaging my dogs in enrichment activities on top of feeding, affection & outdoor time. When my senior cat had health issues right before a trip, they stepped up and took extraordinary care of him. It means so much to be able to enjoy a vacation knowing my pets are safe and well cared for. It means even more knowing the exceptional care and attention they are receiving with Yesspets. I completely trust them with my pets and my home and very highly recommend them!

I’ve used Pawsitive Pet Sitters for the past two years for my crew of 4 kitties and I cannot recommend them highly enough! Taylor and Brooke provide loving care, quality enrichment, and TREATS during each visit. 😉😻 I especially appreciate the daily journal entry and pictures they send to give me peace of mind regarding my kitties’ wellbeing. PPS is professional, responsive, and caring in their interactions. Most importantly, my kitties are always happy and safe upon my return!
Finding the Pawsitive Petsitter was such a relief. They did such a great job with our two fur babies. They are fantastic!

We wouldn’t use anyone besides Yesspet Pet Care to care for our dog while we’re away from home.  We trust Tracy & her team implicitly to care for our senior skittish dog. Her team knows how to approach our dog and is very respectful of her need for personal space. They are kind, caring and very professional. We love the daily journal entries and photos while we’re away so that we can see how our fur baby is doing. That really allows us to relax and enjoy our trip. So, if you are looking for a professional pet sitter, we highly recommend Yesspet Pet Care!!!

Arguably the best pet sitter I’ve ever had the pleasure of working with. As a veterinarian, I have very high standards for pet care, and Tracy and her team (especially Julie our main sitter) go over and above my expectations to take care of my tortoise, happy. I appreciate the daily journals and photos of him while we are away. They will even water my plants, take the trash in, and collect packages so I don’t have to worry about a thing. Thank you for all you do for us!

We recently had the pleasure of using The Pawsitive Pets Sitter services, and we couldn’t be happier! From the moment I contacted them, they were incredibly professional, friendly, and attentive to our pets’ needs. Our kitties were treated with so much love and care, and I could tell they had a true passion for animals. I received regular updates and photos, which gave me peace of mind while we were away. Special shout out to Julie who has been our sitter for our last two trips - she is amazing! Highly recommend The Pawsitive Pets Sitter to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate pet sitter. Thank you for taking such great care of our pets!
